source_summary: Misty Chinese landscape with tree-covered hills, dense lakeside groves, a partially hidden pavilion, winding water and sandbars, and a gnarled foreground willow-like tree. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motif selection.

motifs.name: distant_wooded_ridge
motifs.description: Faint upper-center band of rounded, tree-covered hills receding into mist, isolated from the blank sky and lower groves.

motifs.name: left_autumn_grove
motifs.description: Large left-side grove of clustered trees with pale trunks, dense stippled foliage, and muted reddish autumn accents, excluding the lower-left calligraphy and seals.
must_preserve: soft wash shadows at tree bases
layered tree depth from dark foreground to faint background

motifs.name: hidden_lakeside_pavilion
motifs.description: Small pavilion tucked beneath trees near the lower-left center, including its roof, posts, railings, and immediate enclosing foliage but not the larger unrelated forest mass.
must_preserve: dark ink accents under the eaves
nearby tree trunks partly obscuring the structure
pale wash around the building foundation

motifs.name: central_dense_copse
motifs.description: Dense central cluster of tall trees with dark trunks and rounded stippled crowns rising in front of the distant hills.
must_preserve: irregular canopy edge against the mist

motifs.name: misty_right_copse
motifs.description: Fainter mid-right stand of slender trees and shrubs emerging from atmospheric haze, separated from the central dense copse and open water.

motifs.name: river_sandbar_bend
motifs.description: Winding river surface with pale sandbars and low banks across the middle-right, isolated from the foreground willow and pavilion grove.

motifs.name: right_gnarled_willow
motifs.description: Foreground right gnarled tree with twisting trunk, bare angular branches, drooping willow-like twigs, and sparse foliage tufts, cropped above the lower-right seal area.
must_preserve: contrast between heavy trunk ink and pale surrounding wash

motifs.name: foreground_layered_bank
motifs.description: Low foreground riverbank and marshy shoreline bands across the lower center, with layered washes, small rocks, and grasses, avoiding all seals at the corners.
must_preserve: small dark rock and grass marks
broken ink texture along the shore

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
